_comment: Curated Greenhouse job boards for the multi-source spike. Every token was verified to return HTTP 200 from https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/{token}/jobs on 2026-08-27. Board tokens rot — re-run tests/test_greenhouse_boards.py::test_all_tokens_live (marked slow, manual) to find dead ones. display_name MUST match how the company appears on LinkedIn, because it is what lands in JobPosting.company and feeds the (title, company) dedup key. Never use the raw token as a company name.
_selection_method: Probed 900 randomly sampled greenhouse tokens from a public ATS directory: 515 boards were live (44% rot), 67 carried any Canadian posting, and 16 carried a Canadian PM posting. This list keeps the boards with Canadian PM roles plus those with high Canadian volume (roles rotate, so a board with 27 Canadian jobs and no PM opening today is still worth checking weekly).
